verdict.rationale: Fern's docs show that a docs site has a source repository: Fern Agent reads it and automations open pull requests against it. The CLI publishes documentation, and Fern Editor is pitched as a way to edit 'without... Git', which implies Git is the default workflow. However, nothing in the pack shows that branches, PR previews or merges automatically drive what gets published. missing for 10: documented merge-triggered publishing (CI/GitHub integration), per-branch or per-PR preview deployments, independent corroboration of the git-driven workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, my docs live in my own git repository — branches, pull requests, and merges drive what gets published

citations.quote: Fern Agent reads your docs site’s source repository and makes the changes you describe.
open a pull request when the prompt asks for a change
update documentation without code, markdown, or Git
